solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id,
       id,
       SUM(weight_kg) OVER (
         PARTITION BY customer_id
         ORDER BY booked_at, id
         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS running_kg
FROM shipments
WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY customer_id, booked_at, id;
ambiguities: running_kg is a SUM of integers, so it is bigint, and the ticket names no type.
notes: SUM(weight_kg) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY booked_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) after WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL. Sample customer 1: id 7 at 1412, id 13 at 3398 (1412 + 1986), id 19 at 4825 (3398 + 1427). The ROWS frame and the unique id tiebreak keep the running total unambiguous.
